ai.title: Pass fullResponse to diff expansion to prevent line deletion
ai.summary: Propagates fullResponse through processFileBlock, generatePatch, and expandNewContent to inject assistant message context into the expansion prompt. This mechanism aims to prevent Claude from deleting intermediate lines when expanding shortened file diffs. System prompt updated with explicit instructions to use '// ... existing code ...' placeholders. Scope limited to backend diff generation logic in generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts, generate-patch.ts, and main-prompt.ts.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to make several changes to a code file at once, it sometimes accidentally removes the lines of code that were sitting between your changes. The assistant now keeps more of the original file visible while it works, so the unchanged parts stay in place instead of being dropped. It also got a clearer reminder to mark unchanged sections with a placeholder comment so nothing gets lost during editing. This only affects the internal editing process, so you won't see a new feature, but edited files should now keep all their original code intact.
